A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ASTER GDEM is the most accurate DEM over Australia at the present time, followed by SRTM3 CGIAR-CSI, SRTM1 USGS, and SRTM3 NASA.
the ASTER GDEM is a good choice for global applications, while for regional and local studies, the SRTM DEM is preferable.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the ASTER GDEM 2 is not a suitable substitute for the SRTM DEM for Australia and other regions with a comparable topography.
ASTER GDEM 2 is the least accurate of the three DEMs considered here, but it is also the most complete, covering the entire globe, and is the only one that is freely available at 30 m resolution.
